submitted.rationale: At 2.06 eV, only phases with a band gap near or below about 2.1 eV can absorb, which here means Fe-rich oxides and vanadates (hematite-like). So I spent the merit budget on the Fe-rich corner. Index 22, the composition with the most Fe (Fe 0.585), gave the highest photocurrent: 9e-8 A.

rejected.reason: Measured 1e-8 A. With more V (0.27) and slightly less Fe, the photocurrent fell sharply.
Measured 4e-8 A. Taking out Fe in favour of Ni lowered the photocurrent compared with index 22.
